NAHUALNG 1: First quarter of a three-quarter beginning sequence. Distance learning combined with periodic on-site instruction, conducted primarily in Nahuatl. Course emphasizes developing effective communication at a basic level, covering grammatical structures, vocabulary, and sentence patterns through speaking, reading, writing, and listening in everyday situations. Nahuatl culture. Some knowledge of Spanish is useful.
NAHUALNG 2: Continuation of NAHUALNG 1. Distance learning combined with periodic on-site instruction,conducted primarily in Nahuatl. Course emphasizes continued development of effective communication at a basic level, covering grammatical structures, vocabulary, and sentence patterns through speaking, reading, writing, and listening in everyday situations. Nahuatl culture. Some knowledge of Spanish is useful. Prerequisite: NAHUALNG 1 or placement test.
NAHUALNG 3: Continuation of NAHUALNG 2. Distance learning combined with periodic on-site instruction, conducted primarily in Nahuatl. Course emphasizes continued development of effective communication at a basic level, covering grammatical structures, vocabulary, and sentence patterns through speaking, reading, writing, and listening in everyday situations. Nahuatl culture. Some knowledge of Spanish is useful. Prerequisite: NAHUALNG 2 or placement test. Completion of NAHUALNG 3 fulfills the University Foreign Language Requirement.
NAHUALNG 21: Distance learning combined with periodic on-site instruction, conducted primarily in Nahuatl. Continuation of NAHUALNG 1st year sequence integrating language and culture, with emphasis on developing proficiency in oral and written discourse. Targeted functional abilities include socio culturally appropriate language in formal contexts. Prerequisite: Placement Test, NAHUALNG 3
NAHUALNG 22: Distance learning combined with periodic on-site instruction, conducted primarily in Najuatl. Continuation of NAHUALNG 21 sequence integrating language and culture, with emphasis on developing proficiency in oral and written discourse. Targeted functional abilities include presentational and socio culturally appropriate language in formal and informal contexts. Prerequisite: Placement Test or NAHUALNG 21
NAHUALNG 23: Distance learning combined with periodic on-site instruction, conducted primarily in Nahuatl. Continuation of NAHUALNG 22 sequence integrating language and culture, with emphasis on developing proficiency in oral and written discourse. Targeted functional abilities include presentational and socio culturally appropriate language in formal and informal contexts. Prerequisite: Placement Test, NAHUALNG 22
NAHUALNG 101: Distance learning combined with periodic on-site instruction, conducted in Najuatl. Course focuses on developing advanced proficiency in oral and written Nahuatl. Emphasis on functional abilities that integrate language and culture in formal, informal, academic and professional contexts. Prerequisite- Placement test or NAHUALNG 23

Emphasis on functional abilities that integrate language and culture in formal, informal, academic and professional contexts.
